potential_unspecified_behavior: On the see-all page each appended-page SkeletonGrid is a separate VideoGrid that measures its own width; it matches the loaded grid only because both sit in the same padded container. That holds today, but nothing structurally ties the two together.
regression_risks: The 320px video minimum means some widths that used to show 3 or more video columns now show 2, which changes the shelf card count (c×rowsFor(c)). This is the intended change, but users will see it.
test_coverage: card-grid.test.ts guards 9 grid sites, the per-file gap values and VideoGrid.tsx's inclusion.
